source.title: Path-migration manifest — LLP 0276 Phase 0
source.derivation: Rows are a mechanical, reviewed projection of the completed Phase 0 survey; currentPathExpression remains evidence and targetExpression is the migration obligation.

epoch.contract: The committed current epoch is authoritative for canonical proof. Phase 1, Phase 2, and Phase 3 advance it in the same series as their moves. --epoch is an explicit diagnostic override and never inferred from wall-clock time or Git history.

categories.description: Cargo commands, source arguments, and binary paths.
Tracked hooks, launchd installers/templates, and scheduled runners.
Committed records whose keys or contents name source paths.
Cargo path dependencies, build-script inputs, compile-time includes, runtime manifest-dir joins, and readiness receipts.
Source closures and dirty-tree pathspecs used by receipts and publication checks.
Affected-proof and frozen-record selection rules keyed by repository paths.
Workflow path filters, commands, cache paths, and their frozen test projection.
Active agent/process documentation and guide commands that depend on repository layout.
Checks and tests that open implementation files by repository-relative path.
Authored Guide source= directives and their generated flat projections.
SNAPBACK_REPO_ROOT and other repository-root resolution idioms.
Cloudflare target-relative escapes, target install roots, and per-client roots.
Complete src/bin and explicit [[bin]] mapping to target workspace crates.
Named search projections, activation epochs, and category-based exceptions consumed by the checker.
